scientific_integrity: The proof establishes all parameter ranges; finite independent computations are corroborative, not exhaustive evidence. No independent audit was conducted.
scientific_limitations: Proves intrinsic Euclidean geometry and facet structure for integer n>=1, k>=2. The exponentially small graph edge expansion is a published input for k=2 only, not a newly proved expansion theorem. The v2 revision of the motivating paper and the full text of the related Stanley-triangulation Cayley work were not available for complete comparison; historical priority remains provisional.
title: Linear facet complexity and cube-scale inballs in low-expansion Boolean Cayley polytopes
